title: The well-posedness of stochastic Korteweg--de Vries equations revisited
summary: In this paper, we propose a new view, which leads to almost sure well-posedness in $H^{s}(\mathbb{R}), s\geq 0$, for studying stochastic KdV equations. Different from \cite{de1999white} or \cite{kdvmuti}, by introducing a solution space inspired by \cite{guo2009global}, we prove the local well-posedness result only under natural $H^s(\mathbb{R}), s\geq 0$ conditions parallel to deterministic KdV equations.
